normalization: All hypotheses were rescored with report_entity_backend_comparison.norm/score (ZhITN, OpenCC t2s, NFKC, casefold, remove Unicode P/Z/C; clipped canonical mention counts and normalized character CER). No stored percentages were mixed.

old_scene_test_1829.comparison_scope: Existing scene-evaluation entity_audio_raw output versus cached Qwen and final selected nativehotword/hybrid on exactly the 1829 backend test IDs.

short_finish_test_230.comparison_scope: Only the existing 230 short-finish test IDs; includes cached Qwen, current short-finish entity_audio_raw output, final selected nativehotword/hybrid, and older scene entity_audio_raw. This partial subset is not representative of all 1829 test samples.

old_scene_test_1829.scope_note: Observed durations from prior Web/module result records for these exact IDs. module_elapsed_seconds and incremental review fields describe the entity-review path; web_request_* are whole request/settled totals including the surrounding service path. short_finish_replay_audio_seconds measures replayed audio duration, not wall time. None are native CPU timings or measured concurrent backend latency.

short_finish_test_230.scope_note: Observed durations from prior Web/module result records for these exact IDs. module_elapsed_seconds and incremental review fields describe the entity-review path; web_request_* are whole request/settled totals including the surrounding service path. short_finish_replay_audio_seconds measures replayed audio duration, not wall time. None are native CPU timings or measured concurrent backend latency.

observed_review_timings.comparison_warning: These are observed durations recorded by the earlier Web/entity-review evaluations. They describe that path's recorded scope; they are reported separately and are not native CPU compute or concurrent end-to-end backend latency.

limits: The short-finish run remains partial: 315 total IDs (85 dev and 230 test), so its test subset cannot represent the full 1829-sample test set.
Stored historical score percentages are not reused; all compared arms are rescored from their available texts with one normalization/scoring implementation.
Existing module timing values are retained with their recorded time scope and must not be compared as native inference latency.
